title: My alarm failed to go off at it's scheduled time
body: We are so sorry that this happened. To help help diagnose the issue, please test the alarm that failed by adjusting its time for a minute or two from now, making sure it is toggled on and then locking your iPhone. Note whether it fires as expected, then reach out to us using the contact button below. Be sure to include as much context as you can about your alarm settings and what is happening.
